test_cases.description: Test cases for multi-step prompt flow with different image types and analysis scenarios

test_scenarios.name: Comprehensive Analysis - Landscape Image
test_scenarios.description: Test comprehensive analysis of a landscape image

expected_outputs.vision_analysis: Should include terrain, vegetation, weather, and natural features
expected_outputs.text_generation: Should provide context about the landscape and its characteristics

test_scenarios.name: Object Identification - Urban Scene
test_scenarios.description: Test object identification in an urban environment
test_scenarios.user_prompt: What objects and buildings can you see?

expected_outputs.vision_analysis: Should identify buildings, vehicles, people, and urban infrastructure
expected_outputs.text_generation: Should categorize and describe objects found

test_scenarios.name: Emotional Analysis - Portrait
test_scenarios.description: Test emotional content analysis of a portrait
test_scenarios.user_prompt: What emotions does this person convey?

expected_outputs.vision_analysis: Should analyze facial expressions, mood, and emotional indicators
expected_outputs.text_generation: Should interpret emotional context and atmosphere

validation_criteria: Context is considered in emotional interpretation

test_scenarios.name: Text Extraction - Document
test_scenarios.description: Test text extraction from a document image
test_scenarios.user_prompt: Read the text in this document

expected_outputs.vision_analysis: Should identify and read all visible text
expected_outputs.text_generation: Should organize and present extracted text clearly

test_scenarios.name: Creative Description - Artwork
test_scenarios.description: Test creative description of an artwork
test_scenarios.user_prompt: Create a creative story about this artwork

expected_outputs.vision_analysis: Should analyze artistic elements, style, and composition
expected_outputs.text_generation: Should create engaging narrative or creative description

test_scenarios.name: Complex Scene - Event
test_scenarios.description: Test analysis of a complex event scene
test_scenarios.user_prompt: Describe this event and what's happening

expected_outputs.vision_analysis: Should identify event type, participants, activities, and setting
expected_outputs.text_generation: Should provide context about the event and its significance

test_scenarios.name: Technical Analysis - Product
test_scenarios.description: Test technical analysis of a product image
test_scenarios.user_prompt: What are the technical features of this product?

expected_outputs.vision_analysis: Should identify product components, features, and specifications
expected_outputs.text_generation: Should explain technical aspects and functionality

test_scenarios.name: Mood Analysis - Abstract
test_scenarios.description: Test mood analysis of abstract imagery
test_scenarios.user_prompt: What mood or feeling does this abstract image convey?

expected_outputs.vision_analysis: Should analyze colors, patterns, and abstract elements
expected_outputs.text_generation: Should interpret emotional and atmospheric qualities
